title: Senolytic Agent Improve the Benefit of Platelet-Rich Plasma and Losartan

sections.abstract: The purpose is to explore the possible benefit of administration of Fisetin, (a senolytic agent) to improve the benefit of Platelet-Rich Plasma and losartan for treatment of femoroacetabular impingement and labral tear. We believe that giving Fisetin, a senolytic agent, will improve the benefit of PRP by eliminating senescent cells and senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), known to exist in PRP. The main objectives of this study are to determine if pre- and post-operative administration of a senolytic agent will improve the beneficial effects of PRP when used in conjunction with surgical treatment of FAI and/or labral tear, to determine whether pre- and postoperative administration of Fisetin is associated with adverse events, and to determine if pre- and post-operative administration of Fisetin leads to a decrease in systemic senescence, serum SASP, and fibrotic markers. Patients suffering from femoroacetabular impingement and labral tear, who are planning to undergo hip arthroscopy combined with standard of care intra-operative PRP injection and post-operative losartan administration will be recruited from the clinical practice of the Principal Clinical Investigator or his designee at The Steadman Clinic (TSC).
